title: Amethyst Mod
description: Expands amethyst with new uses, items, and crafting possibilities.
body:
**This mod adds <font color="#9146FF">Amethyst Tools</font>
and allows players to craft a full set of tools using <font color="#9146FF">amethyst</font>
. The recipes are the same as vanilla tool recipes, only replacing the original material with <font color="#9146FF">amethyst</font>
. This makes progression simple and familiar. These tools are stronger than <font color="#0000AA">diamond tools</font>
but weaker than <font color="#92868a">netherite tools</font>
.**
